confidence_notes: Recent Auckland price-index data supports the restaurant and coffee anchors; a current local bar guide gives cocktail and wine ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general destination knowledge and are less certain, with substantial seasonal and booking variation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city used. Auckland is treated as a high-cost Oceania gateway city; food and drink estimates use local Auckland benchmarks while accommodation remains a broad city-level model estimate.
